name: Cybercombat2089
source:
This is the story of a young man. After the death of his mother and the accident that injured him and his father, He was left as an orphan with serious trauma and had to survive alone. He did so for 5 years until he turned 19 when his life would change for the better. Gradually, our hero will no longer be lonely but will be accompanied by beauties who will help him in his adventure. Another thing is that this game will not only have purely sexual scenes, but there will also be a plot with several fight scenes and different endings, good and bad, where you can decide the fate of the protagonist, and you expect to download the game and start in this somewhat futuristic world.

[From [url=https://kvproduccion.itch.io/cybercombat2089-version1-1-developing]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
故事的主角是個年輕人。母親去世後，一場事故又讓他和父親雙雙受傷。最後，他成了孤兒，帶著深重的創傷獨自求生。他就這樣撐了五年，直到十九歲，生活終於有了好轉的機會。漸漸地，他身邊有了願意在冒險中幫助他的美麗夥伴，再也不用孤身一人。這款遊戲除了性愛場景，也有完整劇情、多場戰鬥，以及好壞不同的結局，主角的命運由你決定。下載遊戲，在這個帶點未來色彩的世界開始冒險吧！
